lines.en: : Hah...
: How’d it go? Were you able to say everything you wanted to say?
: Who knows? I think it went well, but I’m notoriously bad at judging how things are going while they’re actually, you know, happening.
: Well, you’re not alone there. I think Otoha’s mad at me since I didn’t talk Chika out of joining the light music club with us.
: You left the manga club? It’s not because of the whole Molly thing, is it?
: No. That doesn’t really have anything to do with it.
: Okay. Good. Because I’m calling her in and the two of you are going to be running the rest of the shift together.
: I’m sorry, what?
: Think you can deal with each other long enough to keep the cafe from burning down?
: Haruka, you understand that leaving me alone to run the shift with Molly means that I’m basically going to be running things alone, right?
: Yeah. But I trust you and think you can handle it.
: Oh, you’re good. You know I won’t be able to say no after flattery like that.
: Fuck it. Bring on the weeb. I got this shit.
: Thanks, Rin. I appreciate that.
: What are you gonna do, then? Go meet up with Makoto’s mom? Or are you gonna go back home and try to erase all the traces of Sensei for when your husband comes back?
: I still have no idea when my husband will be coming back, nor do I understand what “traces” Sensei would even leave behind.
: Oh, you know. Condoms. Razors. All kinds of...manly stuff. Whatever dudes carry around with them.
: He has no need for condoms when that’s absolutely not the type of relationship we have.
: Hey, I didn’t say they had to be for you. He’s a popular guy, you know? He could be slamming some girl he just met on the street right now and we’d have no idea.
: I just hope he didn’t leave all his condoms at your house.
: Rin.
: You know, I’d really appreciate it if you’d stop pointing out my infidelity now that my husband has come back into the picture.
: Why? If your heart’s with Sensei, what good does waiting on him even do?
: Rin-
: I’m serious, Haruka.
: I love you and want you to be happy. And I feel like you’ll be making a big mistake if you just cut everything off because of one phone call.
: You should know by now that this isn’t something I can just cut off. It’s a lot more complicated than that.
: Well, whatever the case may be, I’d like to reinforce my role on Team Sensei. And no, it’s not just because I want to watch you guys do it.
: Which I might.
: I mean, what? Who said that?
: Don’t fire me.
: Rin...stop.
: So, what now? How are you gonna kick off your girls’ day out on the town?
: We’re not going out on the town. And frankly, I’d be surprised if Maki even would go out on the town with me after how I treated her yesterday.
: Well, it’s not like you meant to treat her that way, is it? You had your own stuff going on. It’s only natural to think about that first.
: As long as you can apologize and be sincere about it, I’m sure you guys can work it out.
: Yeah...I’m just not really sure how to apologize for something as serious as this. Especially when she’s going through one of the hardest things she’ll ever have to right now.
: Yeah...after starting to piece things together, I can kinda see that...
: I wish I had some sort of advice I could give you...but I’ve never really been good at dealing with that sort of thing myself either and-
: Wait! What about flowers?
: Flowers?
: Yeah!
: Any time my mom gets into a fight with my other mom, she always buys her flowers to say she’s sorry. Then, before you know it, they’re back to normal like there was never any fight at all.
: This might not work since you and Maki don’t have sex with each other, but I think it’s worth a shot!
: Who says Maki and I don’t have sex with each other?
: Come again?
: Kidding.
: But...yeah. Maybe a gesture like that would make things a little bit better. Thanks for the suggestion, Rin.
: Were you really kidding just now? And, if so, can you tell me you weren’t?
: Nope. I’ve got things to do.
: I’ll call Molly now and make sure she comes over, but I’m going to head out if that’s okay with you. You’ll be fine alone for a little while, right?
: Rin?
: Okay. See you later, then.
Somewhere else, shortly after....
Flowers, flowers, all around us; to grow and then decay-
To parallel our livelihoods and mirror passing days.
When you speak into that mirror, what is it you will say?
Are you excited for the future? Or do you wish it all away?
To heart, my friends and family! For these mirrors are just jokes!
The flowers reek of simile! The metaphors of oak!
Reverse! Return! Repeat your words! If you keep them in, you’ll choke.
Press the flowers to your nose; breathe them in like smoke.
- The girl who cannot breathe
Hello!
Narrator here again.
Did you miss me?
I’ve decided to drop in and speak to you directly about what might be happening while you’re away.
It’s come up in the past — the question of trees falling in forests and whether or not they make sounds — and I’d like to confirm here and now that they do!
The issue is that the sounds happen so far away from all of us that’s it’s kind of hard to pinpoint exactly what noises are produced.
So all we have to go off of are past experiences. Memories of what sounds should be made and how long they will last.
Perhaps what you will see next is one of those assumptions.
Or perhaps I just like playing games with you.
Does it happen?
Does it not?
You will never know!
But I will.
And you are lucky that I am willing to share even this much.
Sayonara.
: Let’s see...I think flowers should be-
: You! With the boobs! Come here!
: Huh? Me?
: Yes! You! Help me!
: Umm...
: Hurry! This is an emergency! My entire life hangs in the balance of this very decision!
: How can I-
: Pink or blue?!
: Uhh...can I ask what the occasion is?
: Repentance!
: I think I need a little more to go off of than just that.
: I think pink is probably the right choice. Blue comes on too strong. Pink is like “Please forgive me,” while blue is like “I’m fucking sorry, okay?”
: Umm...
: Here. Take these. I have made my decision and you look like you’re here for flowers as well.
: Is that...really how I-
: Well, I guess I don’t have to look for flowers anymore.
: Mmm...I don’t know about this. I’m starting to have second thoughts about pink.
: You know, this whole ordeal would be a hell of a lot easier if they had yellow. I always get yellow. This is the first time I have ever been faced with such a tough decision.
: Also, hi. Nice to meet you. I swear I’m not normally as crazy as this. You just caught me at a weird time.
: Oh, it’s fine. This is nothing compared to one of the girls I have to deal with pretty much every day.
: You have kids?
: Me? No way. Just a bunch of part timers at a cafe I own about a mile away from here.
: Cafe?
: Uhh...yeah. Like...you know. A place that serves coffee?
: Dude, I know what a cafe is. I was just thinking that’s a crazy coincidence since my daughter also works at a cafe about a mile away from here.
: I’m not allowed to go there, though. She says I’ll embarrass her. But I don’t seem that embarrassing, do I?
: Um...just out of curiosity, your daughter wouldn’t happen to be-
: Interested in coming to work for you instead? No way. She loves her job. Even if I’m not allowed to go there. But nice try, random rival cafe lady.
: What? No, I-
: Anyway, it was nice talking to you! Hope that whoever you’re giving those flowers to likes the color blue and how aggressively apologetic it is!
: Oh! And if you need a card as well, they’re to the right of the check-out counter!
: If you bend all the corners, they’ll even give you a discount!
: Anyway, bye! Time to go salvage my love life!
: Wait, miss. You still have to pay for-
: Sorry, can’t talk right now! Keep the change!
: ...those.
Roughly one hour later, in a room less joyous.
I have no poem nor words of consolation for you this time.
Just a glimpse into what may or may not be happening behind your back.
And how things can be painful even without you.
Sometimes, a tree falls so hard that it can be heard from miles away.
And other times-
It’s like an entire forest has collapsed.
: FUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUCK!!!!!!!!!!!!
: FUCK FUCK FUCK FUCK FUCK! WHY US?! AM I NOT STRUGGLING ENOUGH ALREADY?! I NEED TO STRUGGLE MORE?!
: Hey...you’re going to be okay. You’ve been doing great without him. Much better than me, at least.
: I DON’T WANT TO DO IT WITHOUT HIM, SARA! I DON’T WANT TO DO THIS ALONE!
: I LOVED HIM! I STILL LOVE HIM! AND NOW HE’S FUCKING GONE! JUST LIKE THAT! WITHOUT EVEN SAYING ANYTHING!
: DO YOU HAVE ANY IDEA WHAT THE LAST THING I SAID TO HIM WAS?! DO YOU?!
: Maki...
: Here! I’ll tell you! It was “Don’t fuck too many aliens!”
: That was the last thing I ever said to him! And I can’t take that back!
: I never thought something like this would happen, Sara! I never realized how cruel and unfair life can be!
: I know...I know...
: It really is cruel, isn’t it?...
: How we never realize how close to the end things are...
: THAT FUCKING IDIOT!
: WHY DID HE TELL ME EVERYTHING WOULD BE FINE?! WHY DID I BELIEVE HIM?!
: THIS ISN’T FINE AT ALL! THAT FUCKING MORON! ASSHOLE! UNGRATEFUL BASTARD!
: FUCKING...DOUCHEBAG! WORTHLESS PIECE OF SHIT! HOW COULD YOU FUCKING DO THIS TO US?!
: That’s right...let it all out...
: It’s okay to cry here...
: WAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAaaAaAAAAaaaaaahhh!!!!!!!!!!!!!
: MASAHIRO!!! YOU FUCKING ASSHOLE!!! HOW COULD YOU?!?! HOW COULD YOU?!?!?!?!?!
: Maki...why did you hold this in for so long?
: HOW THE FUCK WOULD YOU KNOW HOW LONG I’VE HELD IT IN, HARUKA?!
: WHILE YOU WERE BUSY CELEBRATING, I WAS BREAKING THE NEWS TO MY BABY GIRL THAT THE MAN SHE'S LOOKED UP TO SINCE SHE WAS LITTLE IS NEVER COMING HOME!
: I’m not here to make excuses. Not being there for you was horrible of me. But you’ve always been the type to hold things in until they don’t fit anymore and-
: THIS IS DIFFERENT!
: I HAVE TO DO THAT NOW! IT’S NOT A CHOICE ANYMORE!
: I’M A SINGLE FUCKING PARENT NOW! I HAVE TO BE STRONG!
: I CAN’T JUST FUCK AROUND ANYMORE! SOMEONE ELSE’S FEELINGS ARE AT STAKE!
: I’m not saying you should fuck around...I’m saying that your daughter is smart enough to realize you’re hurting too and-
: STOP TALKING TO ME LIKE YOU UNDERSTAND WHAT’S GOING ON! STOP TALKING LIKE YOU UNDERSTAND HOW I FEEL!
: Maki! She was just trying to-
: SHE SHOULD HAVE BEEN THERE! SHE SHOULD HAVE BEEN THERE FOR ME!
: How many times have you called me to cry about your problems?! How many times have I sat there listening to them?! Consoling you for things you shouldn’t even have to be consoled for!
: Your husband is still alive and mine has been dead for two fucking months! Two months, Haruka!
: My daughter lost her father and you didn’t even come over to see how we were doing!
: I called-
: ONE FUCKING TIME!
: YOU CALLED ONE TIME!
: Is that seriously all I’m worth to you?
: Did you think you could just fucking show up here with flowers in your hand and make it all okay?
: Don’t tell me I shouldn’t be holding things in when letting them out makes the whole world fucking implode.
: And don’t pity me either. Because the idea of someone who can’t handle her own problems telling me how to handle mine is just insulting.
: She doesn’t mean that, Haru-chan...She doesn’t.
: It’s not fair.
: It’s just not fair.
: Why couldn’t my husband live too?
: Why couldn’t I have gotten the same call you did?
: Because I’m lucky...theres nothing more to it than that.
: If the outcome of our phone calls was based on who we are as people or how decent we’ve been to each other...I know our positions would be swapped right now.
: And I know that you would have been the first one to get in contact with me.
: I wasn’t, and I’m sorry for that. I’ll be sorry for it for the rest of my life.
: What I won’t do is give up on telling you when I think you’re making things harder for yourself than they have to be.
: No one’s expecting you to hold yourself together, and I’m sure that includes your daughter.
: Also, I didn’t buy you these flowers to try and make everything okay. I bought them because I think you deserve something nice now that everything else has been taken away from you.
: And also because I was pressured into it by some woman in the convenience store who may or may not be the mother of one of my employees.
: The point is, I wasn’t there for you when I should have been.
: But I’m here now, asking for forgiveness when I know I don’t deserve it because beneath the selfishness and inability to look forward, I love you.
: Haruka, I...I didn’t mean to hit you. I’m just...
: It really hurts...
: I’ve never felt so alone before...
: Sara, can you take these flowers from me for a second?
: Huh?...Sure, but...
: Come here.
: I don’t care that you hit me, Maki. It’s not a big deal.
: You’re...sniff...only saying that because...sniff...you like it rough...
: No. I’m saying that because after all of the times you’ve been there for me, the least I can do to make it up to you is let you knock me around a little bit.
: Just...sniff...be there for me. That’s all I want...
: I will. I promise.
: But in the meantime, cry as much as you want. I took the day off to spend it with you. And if that means becoming a handkerchief, so be it.
: Also, I hope that you’re okay with blue. The girl at the convenience store said it might be too “aggressively apologetic.”
: Sniff...
: Blue is my favorite color...
Again, I can’t recall where the day went.

After leaving the cafe, I wandered the streets...half-expecting to bump into a girl fighting a war with herself behind the scenes, trying to reclaim what little sense of dignity I haven’t already robbed her of.
The fact that I didn’t find her at all speaks volumes about the shape she must be in right now.
But at least she’s not alone in her misery- for even further behind the curtain are two more girls.
They both wear glasses. Both have blue eyes. And they both just lost a man who, even in death, will remain far more important to them than I ever will.
Which is why I’m not with them right now.
Sometimes, it’s necessary to settle for second place.
It’s necessary to detach yourself from things you became unintentionally glued to.
To slip out of your skin...and wander deep into the darkness, for that’s the only place you won’t be able to hurt anyone.
But sometimes, the ones you fear hurting find you.
Because, contrary to what you may believe-
You are never truly alone in the dark.
In the bowels of the night, unconscious as you are, you swallow a spider.
You awaken with a mouth full of eggs.
